title: An Open-System Cosmological Model: Modeling Dark Energy Expansion and Cosmological Black Hole Coupling as a Thermodynamic Steady-State Influx from a Higher-Dimensional Bulk
summary: I present a novel, non-equilibrium thermodynamic framework that models the three-dimensional observable universe as an open, self-regulating metabolic system embedded within a higher-dimensional parent manifold (the Bulk). Rather than treating cosmic expansion as an uncollateralized internal runaway explosion, I demonstrate that the accelerating scale factor is driven by a passive, cross-dimensional wave-energy influx, which arises naturally from a steep potential gradient between the hyper-dense, highly organized Bulk and our lower-density vector universe.
